mapper.select: SELECT #{now} AS capturedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_processing_job WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY')) AS queuedJobs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_processing_job WHERE status = 'RUNNING') AS runningJobs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_processing_job WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND updated_at >= #{last24Hours}) AS failedJobsLast24Hours, GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(created_at), #{now}) FROM material_processing_job WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY')), 0), 0) AS oldestQueuedSeconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence_read_lease WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > #{now}) AS activeReadLeases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence_read_lease WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at <= #{now}) AS expiredReadLeases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material WHERE lifecycle_state IN ('DELETE_PENDING', 'DELETING') AND updated_at <= #{stuckBefore}) AS stuckDeletingMaterials, GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(updated_at), #{now}) FROM material WHERE lifecycle_state IN ('DELETE_PENDING', 'DELETING')), 0), 0) AS oldestDeletionSeconds, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(page_count), 0) FROM material_processing_usage WHERE recorded_at >= #{monthStart}) AS indexedPagesThisMonth, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retrieval_vector_batch WHERE state = 'READY' AND (last_reconciled_at IS NULL OR last_reconciled_at < #{reconciliationStaleBefore})) AS staleVectorBatches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_projection_repair_audit WHERE state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')) AS openProjectionRepairs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_projection_orphan_deletion_audit WHERE completed_at IS NULL) AS pendingOrphanDeletions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_index_generation WHERE state = 'PURGING') AS purgingGenerations

SELECT captured_at AS capturedAt, sequence_no AS sequence, embedding_percent AS embeddingPercent, vector_read_percent AS vectorReadPercent, vector_write_percent AS vectorWritePercent, dependencies_available AS dependenciesAvailable FROM material_provider_capacity_snapshot WHERE singleton_key = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_provider_capacity_snapshot ( singleton_key, captured_at, sequence_no, embedding_percent, vector_read_percent, vector_write_percent, dependencies_available ) VALUES (1, #{capturedAt}, #{sequence}, #{embeddingPercent}, #{vectorReadPercent}, #{vectorWritePercent}, #{dependenciesAvailable}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE captured_at = IF(VALUES(sequence_no) > sequence_no, VALUES(captured_at), captured_at), embedding_percent = IF(VALUES(sequence_no) > sequence_no, VALUES(embedding_percent), embedding_percent), vector_read_percent = IF(VALUES(sequence_no) > sequence_no, VALUES(vector_read_percent), vector_read_percent), vector_write_percent = IF(VALUES(sequence_no) > sequence_no, VALUES(vector_write_percent), vector_write_percent), dependencies_available = IF(VALUES(sequence_no) > sequence_no, VALUES(dependencies_available), dependencies_available), sequence_no = GREATEST(sequence_no, VALUES(sequence_no))
